"""Scenario tests for the controller protocol semantics."""
import sys, json, importlib
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')

fails = []

def fresh():
    for m in ['service','controller','planner','schema','fcflow','wire']:
        if m in sys.modules: del sys.modules[m]
    import service
    return service.handle

def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((name, got, want))
        print('FAIL', name, '\n  got ', got, '\n  want', want)

def run(name, cmds, wants):
    h = fresh()
    for i,(c,w) in enumerate(zip(cmds,wants)):
        got = h(json.loads(c) if isinstance(c,str) else c)
        if w is not None:
            check('%s#%d'%(name,i), got, w)
    return h

# ---- about / not loaded -------------------------------------------------
run('about', ['{"op":"about"}'], [{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}])
run('notloaded', ['{"op":"audit","at":[0]}','{"op":"advance","time":5}',
                  '{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[],"force":false}',
                  '{"op":"prepare","id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,2],"period":1,"participants":[[0,1],[1,1]],"envelope":[],"rev":0}',
                  '{"op":"commit","id":"a","owner":"o","rev":0}',
                  '{"op":"cancel","id":"a","owner":"o","rev":0}'],
    [{'status':'error','code':'NOT_LOADED','rev':0}]*6)
run('about_after_ops', ['{"op":"audit","at":[]}','{"op":"about"}'],
    [{'status':'error','code':'NOT_LOADED','rev':0},{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}])

# ---- load ---------------------------------------------------------------
L2 = '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,5]],"bookings":[]}'
run('load_basic', [L2, L2, '{"op":"about"}'],
    [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},{'status':'error','code':'ALREADY_LOADED','rev':0},
     {'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}])
# schema invalid loads
bad_loads = [
 '{"op":"load","n":1,"links":[],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":49,"links":[],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,0,1]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,2,1]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":3,"links":[[0,1,1],[1,0,2]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,-1]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1.0]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,true]],"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1]]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[[0,1]]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[[0,0]]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[[0,1],[0,1]]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[[0,1]]},{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[1,1],"envelope":[]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[],"extra":1}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"a!","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"bookings":[{"id":"","owner":"o","window":[0,1],"envelope":[]}]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,1]],"extra":0,"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":0,"bookings":[]}',
 '{"op":"load","n":2.0,"links":[],"bookings":[]}',
]
for i,b in enumerate(bad_loads):
    run('badload%d'%i, [b, L2], [{'status':'invalid'}, {'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0}])
# overbooked first load -> invalid, and state unchanged (still unloadable? no: invalid has no effect)
ob = '{"op":"load","n":2,"links":[[0,1,3]],"bookings":[{"id":"a","owner":"o","window":[0,5],"envelope":[[0,2]]},{"id":"b","owner":"o","window":[1,6],"envelope":[[0,2]]}]}'
run('overbook', [ob, L2], [{'status':'invalid'},{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0}])
# later load that overbooks is not evaluated -> ALREADY_LOADED
run('later_overbook', [L2, ob], [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},{'status':'error','code':'ALREADY_LOADED','rev':0}])
# touching bookings at a point is fine

run('touch_ok', [ok2], [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0}])

print('fails', len(fails))
